# Meter { #anylumino.Meter }

```python
Meter(value=0.0, description='', variant='informative', readout=False, **kwargs)
```

Spectrum meter display control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                                                                                        | Default         |
|-------------|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------|
| value       | optional | Initial value and synced Python value.                                                                             | `0.0`           |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control.                                                                                     | `''`            |
| variant     | optional | Spectrum visual variant such as ``'accent'``, ``'primary'``, ``'negative'``, ``'positive'``, or ``'informative'``. | `'informative'` |
| readout     | optional | Whether to show the current value.                                                                                 | `False`         |
